info.about: Dragon Ball: Advanced Adventure is a 2004 video game developed by Dimps and published by Atari for the Game Boy Advance.
info.trivia: Dimps' game reached North America in June 2006, a year after Europe and more than eighteen months after its November 2004 release in Japan.
info.why: Atari released it in North America in mid-2006, after the Nintendo DS had taken over, and US copies now ask several times the Japanese cartridge.
